# Mixcloud

> > Mixcloud is a global audio platform for discovering, sharing, and curating music mixes across diverse genres, cultures, and radio communities.

Mixcloud serves as a hub for DJs, radio stations, and music creators to share Cloudcasts (audio shows) while building a community around music discovery. The platform emphasizes genre diversity, featuring everything from African music to electronic genres, with integrated radio partnerships and creator resources.

## Key Topics

- Cloudcasts
- Music Genres
- DJ Culture
- Radio Shows
- Music Curation
- Community Radio
- Genre Expansion
- Music Charts
- Creator Resources
- Music Scenes
- Audio Platform
- Global Music
- Music Discovery
- Radio Partnerships
- Editorial Content

## Music Genres & Discovery

- [Mixcloud genres & charts](https://genres.mixcloud.com/): Genre expansion and music charts reflecting Mixcloud community diversity
- [Mixcloud - more genres](https://genres.mixcloud.com/more-genres): Global music genres and charts database across African and international styles

- [Mixcloud Blog - Advice, stories and music to inspire your journey](https://blog.mixcloud.com/): Mixcloud blog featuring music advice, DJ culture, and creator resources
